First off, Youtube has gone downhill for several years now. Every update is just a UI change that is completely unnecessary. Why? There is seriously no point to it. The recent update has videos take up the entire screen. It's an eyesore. Also, what's with all the ads? They're EVERYWHERE. I'm waiting for the day someone develops a site that completely kills Youtube.

I remember when this app was PERFECT or at least USABLE. Yes, we had ads. BUT THEY WEREN’T ANNOYING AND CONSTANT. Now every time I open YouTube, it’s just a plague of ads and interruptions. Ads in the search. Ads before videos. Ads every few minutes DURING videos. And now I’m even getting ads WHILE MY VIDEO IS PAUSED?? Let that sink in. I can’t even pause in peace without being bombarded. It completely ruins the experience. You can’t relax, you can’t focus, and you definitely can’t enjoy anything without being interrupted over and over again. It feels less like a video platform and more like an ad platform with videos squeezed in between. And can we talk about how aggressively YouTube pushes Premium?? Every other second it’s “subscribe to Premium” like NO. Maybe fix the app instead of making the free version unbearable just to force people into paying. This is a HUGE downgrade. The app used to feel smooth, enjoyable, and actually user-focused. Now it just feels greedy, cluttered, and exhausting to use. Makes me want to switch platforms like genuinely do better.
